DEVIATION FROM FROZEN (issue #101, A2.0 M:N rework) — RECORDED: identical
deviation to the PROD copy (see mojito_async/vendor/mojito-sys/VENDORED_AT.txt).
The frozen global resume table + _ms_last_* globals (single-thread-only, 32
live-fiber cap) are removed; the return link rides in ms_ctx_t.return_to and
the trampoline derives its own ctx from a stack marker.  Layout grows
168 B -> 176 B; spike Mojo consumers take MS_CTX_SIZE, so offsets follow.
Verified by the spike harness + t27_multithread (two-pthread probe).
